name: MapLegend
intent: Compact, foldable key for what is currently drawn on a map.
when: A map carries more than one kind of marker or layer
Marker colour encodes a dimension the viewer has to decode

chooseOver.because: Legend is a chart key laid out inline with its chart. MapLegend floats over a map, folds away, and draws swatches shaped like the markers they describe.

commonMistakes: Drawing every swatch as the same shape — a key is easier to read when a round entry means a round marker and a dashed entry means a dashed outline.
Letting the legend describe a scheme the map is not currently using — drive its sections from the same state that colours the markers.
Reaching for a heavy drop shadow on a floating map surface — it reads as a modal over the map instead of a panel on it. Use the shared FLOAT_SHADOW.
